project.description: Public bytes-to-records API over the new stack (ASN.1 adoption prerequisite, docs/BACKLOG.md "Parsing (Stage-1)"): compiles a grammar once, then decodes a ByteSource into a lazy stream of NamedNodes (RecordReader + SchemaBinder), with a public NamedNode-to-legacy-record-map converter (RecordMapper, promoted out of asn-golden where it was package-private) and a convenience that carries a decoded record all the way to LegacyTransformEngine's flattened rows. This is the dependency surface a future com.gamma.parse.ParserPlugin adapter builds on — asn-golden stays harness-only (it also pulls in legacy-code) and is not meant to be depended on by production code.
